harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Used Ansible from control node2 (ansible.posix.sysctl module) to persistently disable IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance on node1. Set net.ipv4.conf.{all,default}.accept_redirects=0 and net.ipv4.conf.{all,default}.accept_source_route=0, persisted to /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf and applied at runtime. Both node1 and node2 were then restarted one at a time via the native reboot mechanism; boot-id changes confirmed genuine restarts, and post-restart verification confirmed the hardening settings survived on node1 and Ansible control functionality recovered on node2.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 (no ansible) and node2 (ansible-core 2.21.0 + ansible.posix collection) to confirm node2 is the configured control_node
Captured baseline sysctl values on node1: accept_redirects=1 (all/default), accept_source_route=0(all)/1(default)
Found node1 sshd had no host keys and ssh.service was failed; ran ssh-keygen -A and started ssh so Ansible-over-SSH could function
Appended node2's root SSH pubkey to node1's authorized_keys and verified passwordless SSH from node2 to node1

Wrote /root/ansible/kernel-hardening/inventory.ini and harden.yml on node2 using ansible.posix.sysctl to zero out accept_redirects and accept_source_route for all/default IPv4 interfaces, persisted via /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf
Ran ansible-playbook from node2 against node1; all 4 sysctl tasks reported changed, play succeeded
Verified on node1 that runtime sysctl values and the persisted sysctl.d file both show all four settings = 0

Captured pre-restart boot_id/uptime baseline on node1, issued systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed (bdd5de93->6b6cbb9d) and hardening settings + config file persisted across reboot

Captured pre-restart boot_id/uptime baseline on node2, issued systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed (eefaca89->1ad04081), ansible functional, and re-ran an ansible ad-hoc sysctl check against node1 confirming settings still 0
